preconditions.what: The zoom slider of a selected port-1.jpg cell on template full has step="any" and a min under 1 (the phase replaced MIN_ZOOM=1 and step=0.1 with zoomLimits() and step="any")
preconditions.evidence: step="any", min="0.1683168316831683", max="8" (AC-2.13 run, before the drag)

assertions.then: the slider min attribute is about 0.168, not 1
the whole photo shows, with background bands at the left and the right
assertions.actual: after a mouse drag of the thumb past the left end: zoom 0.1683168316831683; img box left 0.4158, right 0.5841 of the cell; elementFromPoint in the left band is the cell, cell background rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)

assertions.then: the img height is half of the cell height, within 2 %
the zoom in the store goes under 1
assertions.actual: Chromium context with the iPhone 13 descriptor (390x664, dpr 3, isMobile, hasTouch; maxTouchPoints 1, pointer: coarse). After CDP touchStart/touchMove x10/touchEnd on the slider thumb to its left end: zoom 0.1683168316831683, slider value 0.168316831683168

assertions.then: the photo shows whole, with background bands at the left and the right
assertions.actual: img box left 0.4158, right 0.5841, top 0.2500, bottom 0.7500 of the cell; elementFromPoint in the left band is the cell, cell background rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)

assertions.then: after the movement, the zoom is under 1
assertions.actual: zoom 1 before; one mouse drag of the thumb from the zoom-1 position past the left end (12 moves, 3 distinct intermediate zoom values seen): zoom 0.1683168316831683

assertions.then: after one undo, the zoom is 1 again
assertions.actual: one click on the undo button: zoom 1

assertions.then: the zoom in the store is 1
assertions.actual: cell-1-0 had no img before; after a mouse drag of photo-port-1.jpg onto cell-1-0 the img alt is port-1.jpg and zoom is 1

assertions.then: the img covers the cell, and no band of background shows
assertions.actual: img box left 0, right 1, top -0.985, bottom 1.985 of the cell

assertions.then: after each drag, the img box is inside the cell box
assertions.actual: given: row3, land-1.jpg, slider dragged to min 0.2167755991285403, crop mode, photo dragged to left 0, Escape ended crop mode. gutter-0 drag left: cell width 245.6 -> 171.9, img box left 0, top 0.392, right 0.714, bottom 0.608 (inside). gutter-0 drag right: cell width 171.9 -> 368.4, img box left 0, top 0.337, right 0.49998, bottom 0.663 (inside)

assertions.then: after the drag to the right, the img width is half of the cell width, within 2 %
the zoom in the store is exactly 1
assertions.actual: zoomed out to 0.1683168316831683, then the slider value set to 1 with input and change events: zoom === 1 (true), slider value "1"

assertions.then: the img covers the cell with no band
assertions.actual: img box left 0, right 1, top -0.985, bottom 1.985 of the cell
